review_process: Parent source/diff adjudication with separately prompted read-only gpt-5.6-sol/ultra source_ra61_sol, representation_ra61 and adversarial_ra61. Correlated computational review, not independent human or laboratory validation. Exact final head review is recorded in the Git-local run receipt.
source_inspection: Retained six-page main and nine-page SI; primary body text and visual main Figure1/Figure2 and SI FiguresS1-S3, with S4/S5 captions and main assay conditions. Retained witness hashes and byte lengths checked. No new acquisition.

adjudications.objection: A single initial-rate coefficient could become a microscopic arrow rate or include later enzyme regeneration.
adjudications.evidence: Main pp1-3 Conditions for Kinetic Studies and Figure1; Figure1 caption omits proton transfers, binding events and intermediates.
adjudications.decision: Bind the existing parent coefficient once to source steps1-3 and their measured boundary. Add a generic initial-second-order role with one parameter; retain every directional slot as unassigned. Exclude source steps4-5 and product sequestration from the fit.

adjudications.objection: The catalytic substrate iminium and the off-path aldehyde-product Schiff base could be collapsed into one covalent state.
adjudications.evidence: Main Figure1 step2; SI p2 FigureS1 and free-lysine explanation.
adjudications.decision: Keep separate states. Product sequestration uses the free-enzyme/aldehyde pool, not the enamine-bound lysine after step3. Free enzyme can already be present or arise after steps4-5; do not require the same enzyme molecule to produce aldehyde or complete a turnover.

adjudications.objection: Observed fluorescence loss could authenticate covalent occupancy or the designed Lys176 site.
adjudications.evidence: Main p2 product discussion/Figure2B; SI pp2-3 S1-S3 and pp5-6 pH assignment.
adjudications.decision: Optical change is observed; product-iminium identity is the authors model. Keep active-site lysine unnumbered and bind Lys176 only as the design-model label. Signal loss is not a measurement of total product loss or yield.

adjudications.objection: The conditional product Kd could lose its assumptions or become a new kinetic parameter.
adjudications.evidence: SI p3 equation/FigureS3, lack of binding saturation, zero/20%/40% bound-fluorescence assumptions.
adjudications.decision: Resolve the entire existing initial_rate_boundary object onto the fit and off-path transition; reject bare scalars and invalid graph/fit references. Keep 26/17/10uM estimates contextual, not new common observations, an uncertainty interval, substrate KM or microscopic iminium affinity/rates.

adjudications.objection: Using a substrate ligand identity on chemically transformed product states would be ambiguous.
adjudications.evidence: Main Figure1 and SI FigureS1 transform the input substrate; previous POX grouped related states by the input ligand.
adjudications.decision: Introduce explicit source-bound reaction_branch_id semantics, mutually exclusive with the legacy ligand declaration. It records input lineage only, not present ligand identity, chemical participant balance or atom mapping. Preserve all prior model output objects.

adjudications.objection: The same-unit initial-rate or reporter interpretation could transfer from the parent to a mutant.
adjudications.evidence: Original RA61 provider binds its Table4 parent independently of five mutant rows; SI S3 is the parent binding fit.
adjudications.decision: Use the exact existing parent observation, construct, assay and parameter references; reject substitution of a mutant endpoint. The fit has one initial coefficient, excluding hybrid saturated or response-midpoint models.

adjudications.objection: A coherent wholesale semantic rewrite can remain internally consistent.
adjudications.evidence: Source-declared state meanings, measurement boundary and contextual pointer semantics require primary-body interpretation.
adjudications.decision: The public source-review manifest binds exact context and consumer bytes. Generic checks enforce consistency and known failure modes; they do not authenticate chemical truth or confer independent validation.

completion_note: All three source, representation and adversarial roles accepted the exact11 substantive file blobs and this review-record content before status/date finalization. Final publication-head verification is recorded separately in the Git-local receipt.
